findings.problem: The label "अपडेट फिर कोशिश करें" is unidiomatic and does not clearly express retrying the update; it reads approximately as "update, try again" and does not provide the clear button-label distinction this branch requires.
findings.fix: Use "अपडेट दोबारा करें" to label the update retry action clearly and idiomatically, distinct from "फिर कोशिश करें".
